action.sql: SELECT SUM(gl.debit - gl.credit) AS operating_expenses_usd FROM gl_lines gl JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id = gl.account_id JOIN departments d ON d.dept_id = gl.dept_id WHERE gl.entity_id = 'US01' AND d.dept_id = 'ENG' AND a.type = 'Expense' AND a.account_id BETWEEN '6000' AND '6999' AND a.account_id <> '6000' AND gl.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-05'
